crossRefs.note: So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and…
When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them…
All that fell that day, both of men and women, were twelve thousand, even all the people of Ai.
For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that…
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him; for Yahweh your God hardened his spirit and made his heart…
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who didn’t go out after Israel. They left the city open, and pursued Israel.
translations.bsb: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel, leaving the city wide open while they pursued Israel.
translations.kjv: And there was not a man left in Ai or Bethel, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
translations.asv: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth-el, that went not out after Israel: and they left the city open, and pursued after Israel.
